name: Task Capture System
description: Builds a complete task capture system with inbox location, capture criteria, two-minute rule, and processing cadence. Produces a deployable system specification the user can immediately adopt. Use when the user asks about capturing tasks, organizing incoming work, setting up a task inbox, or building a system to track everything they need to do. Do NOT use for prioritizing existing tasks (use task-prioritization), scheduling tasks into time blocks (use time-blocking), or enterprise project intake processes (use business project-management skills).
